verdicts.reason: Compared the four package members together at 1x and 3x on #172336 against the exact Ready baseline. Pixel treatment is coherent and deliberate across all four: crisp stepped edges, compact clusters, binary alpha, no resampling blur or stray pixels; Ready is a flat single-tone stroke while Working, Retry and Paused carry subtle in-shape ramps, which reads as one hand-drawn family rather than a mismatch and is not restricted by the criterion (no palette or stroke rule). Visual weight is coherent with the baseline: Ready 29 opaque pixels at 2 px stroke, Working 32 per frame at 2 px, Retry 54 at 2 px ring, Paused 60 at 3 px bars; Paused is the heaviest and Ready the lightest but all read as mid-weight glyphs of the same size class at native scale, and identical footprint is not required. Each member shows a perceptible cool-blue accent (Ready and the preserved Start share a light sky blue; Working a more saturated azure; Retry and Paused a medium blue) and every exterior is the transparent panel with no matte, halo or fringe. Working's four frames keep the same volume and ramp; its recorded 100 ms playback with the 3->0 wrap is one continuous quarter-turn rotation (reviewed in native-review.working.motion), and its stationary frame zero shown alone under reduce reads as the same spinner at rest, coherent with the siblings.

Viewed Ready, all four Working frames and the loop, Retry, Paused and the preserved Start together at 1x and 3x in colour and in grayscale. By structure alone: Ready is two diagonal strokes meeting at a low point (a check); every Working frame is three disjoint fragments on an open ring that never close into a check, a bar pair, a triangle or a solid shape, so Working never reads as success at any frame or in motion; Retry is a nearly closed continuous ring with an arrowhead, distinct from Working's open fragments by closure and density and from Paused by shape; Paused is two parallel full-height bars, unlike anything else in the set; Start is a solid triangle and remains separately identifiable. Stationary Working frame zero alone in the non-color 1x and 3x views (top bar, right vertical, lower-left curve) is clearly distinct from the Ready check and from Paused's twin bars, which is the required reduced-motion distinction; it is also distinguishable from Retry and Start. Retry and Working both use a circular motif; their structural difference (closed ring plus arrow versus three fragments) carries the distinction without a shared-silhouette rule.
